trl_rationale: Prototype system flight-tested on aircraft in its intended operating environment with measured throughput and range.

evidence.quote: Flight 7 successfully demonstrated the HiWAND link out to a range of 160 miles at an altitude of 35,000 feet.

For a range exceeding 150 miles, transmission control protocol throughput of 4.8 Mbps and user diagram protocol throughput of 4.9 Mbps were achieved using pulse code modulation / frequency modulation over a 5 Mbps telemetry link.

criteria_origin: derived from evidence[].trl_level (the TRL's own level met, higher levels insufficient evidence) and DEMO-C02 met (APCTT-C10 met); lower levels, APCTT-C11 and APCTT-C12 not labelled yet
review_notes: No formal acceptance criteria stated, hence DEMO-C02 insufficient evidence.
